name: demas-theme/branch-finder
title: Branch Finder
description: The Contact page's fifteen branches: a list of cities, the chosen branch's card (who answers there, address, opening hours, directions) and a map of the Kingdom divided into each branch's area (the part nearest that branch). Branches, people, addresses and hours come from the theme's branch list (inc/branches.php); a photo per branch is chosen in the sidebar. /contact-us/#branch-jed opens with Jeddah chosen. Works without JavaScript.
